description:
Lobsters aren't truly immortal, but they never die of old age. They keep the enzyme telomerase active in nearly every tissue, so their chromosome caps keep rebuilding and their cells keep dividing.
A new animal-behaviour fact every day on OTIS — dumb questions, wild answers.
